openscad.help:
OpenSCAD – the official OpenSCAD runs as WebAssembly right in the browser.
• Sizes: OpenSCAD units count as millimetres (switch to cm or m in the “OpenSCAD” panel).
• Axes as in OpenSCAD: Z points up. The result becomes a group with real faces.
• Output of echo() and warnings appear in the console below.
• color() becomes a material (e.g. color("red") → “OpenSCAD red”, with transparency) – only with the Manifold geometry kernel.

File library (“OpenSCAD” panel › Files):
• Add files and whole folders – they are kept in the browser.
• include <…> and use <…> find everything in the library, e.g. include <BOSL2/std.scad>.
• import("part.stl"), import("outline.svg"), surface("height.png") – paths relative to the library.
• text() has built-in fonts: Liberation Sans (default), Liberation Serif and Liberation Mono,
  each regular, bold and italic – e.g. text("Hello", font = "Liberation Serif:style=Bold").
• Your own fonts (.ttf, .otf) in the library are added: text("Hello", font = "Name of the font").
  .ttf/.otf files can also simply be dragged into the window.

In JavaScript scripts:
  s3d.scad('cube([20, 20, 5]);', { at: [1, 0, 0], name: 'Plate' })
  → a group, unit as set in the panel. Any number of calls: before the run enough OpenSCAD instances
    are prepared (for loops the plugin learns the number on the first run).

Opening .scad files: File › Import…, drag & drop or from the file library.
Export: File › Export › OpenSCAD (.scad) – the model as polyhedron().

words.cube: Box – size is a number or [x, y, z].
words.sphere: Sphere with radius r (or d = diameter).
words.polyhedron: Solid from points and faces (point numbers from 0).
words.difference: The first child minus all others.
words.intersection: Only what all children have in common.
words.rotate: Rotate in degrees about X, Y, Z (or rotate(a, v)).
words.mirror: Mirror at the plane with this normal.
words.linear_extrude: Pull a 2D shape into a solid.
words.rotate_extrude: Turn a 2D shape around the Z axis.
words.projection: Project a 3D solid onto the XY plane.
words.import: STL, OFF, 3MF, SVG, DXF from the file library.
words.surface: Height field from an image or file.
words.module: Define a module of your own.
words.function: Define a function of your own.
words.each: Spread a list into a list.
words.use: Use the modules and functions of a file.
words.assert: Stop if the condition does not hold.
words.len: Length of a list or a text.
words.fn: Number of segments for circles, spheres and cylinders.

errors.topLevel2d: The top-level object is 2D – turn it into a 3D object with linear_extrude() or rotate_extrude().
errors.empty: The result is empty – no object was created.
errors.emptyMaybe2d: The result is empty – is the top-level object 2D? Then use linear_extrude().
errors.stillLoading: OpenSCAD is still loading – please run it again in a moment.
errors.tooManyCalls: More than {max} s3d.scad() calls in one run – please combine the OpenSCAD code into fewer calls.
errors.morePrepared: This script needs more OpenSCAD instances than were prepared – {count} are being prepared now. Please run it again in a moment.

openscad.extension: Runs OpenSCAD code (the real OpenSCAD) and inserts the result as a group. Unit as set in the “OpenSCAD” panel (default: mm).

panel.intro: The official OpenSCAD runs as WebAssembly locally in the browser – no installation and no server.
panel.colorsHint: Colours from color() become materials (e.g. “OpenSCAD red”) – only with the Manifold kernel; CGAL delivers no colours.
panel.filesHint: For include, use, import() and fonts for text(). Kept in the browser. Paths as in the folder, e.g. {example}.
panel.license: OpenSCAD is free software under the GPL (openscad.org, github.com/openscad/openscad). The WebAssembly build comes from the npm package “openscad-wasm” and ships with this plugin package; the app itself does not contain it.
